name: GD-RL Bridge
description: Exposes Geometry Dash as a lockstep reinforcement-learning environment over localhost TCP.

port.name: Bridge port
port.description: Localhost TCP port the Python environment connects to. Restart the game after changing it.

snapshot-load.name: Snapshot load method
snapshot-load.description: How LOAD_STATE restores a snapshot: 0 = practice-mode respawn at the saved checkpoint, 1 = reset then loadFromCheckpoint. For debugging.

legacy-view.name: Legacy object view
legacy-view.description: Send objects the way the bridge did before 2026-10-13 (no block merging, no No-Touch/speed-portal handling, +-20 blocks vertically). For replaying policies trained then (Stereo Madness).

show-hitboxes.name: Show the agent's view
show-hitboxes.description: Draw in the level what the agent sees: the hitboxes the bridge reports, the 8 objects its encoder looks at (numbered), its field of view, and the player's recent path (blue while the agent holds the button, orange while released). For watching and recording; leave off for training.

watch-mode.name: Watch mode
watch-mode.description: Under an agent, serve at most one STEP per rendered frame, for watching a client that paces its STEPs in real time. Leave off for training (it caps the step rate at the frame rate).
